title: Try a Hobie Kayak at The Tinley Park Fishing Show – Feb 13-14
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Watersports brought its Hobie demo fleet to the Tinley Park Fishing Show on February 13-14, 2016.
body_html: Test drive a Hobie Kayak Feb. 13-14 at the Tinley Park Fishing Show @ Tinley Park High School. This will be your last chance in 2016 to enjoy best-of-the-year, show-special deals…we’ll have the demo fleet in the pool & ready to roll! Make a Hobie Kayak your PERFECT Valentine’s treat! We’ll be there 9am-5pm Saturday & Sunday.
seo_title: Try a Hobie Kayak at Tinley Park Fishing Show
seo_description: Test drive a Hobie Kayak at the Tinley Park Fishing Show, February 13-14, 2016, at Tinley Park High School. Show-special deals and the demo fleet on hand.
